synopsis.text: The Avengers, and the general public, anxiously await Hank Pym’s trial. But with Egghead alive and vengeful, the Masters of Evil may interrupt the due process of law!

Dr. Henry Pym has his day in court to clear his name! Will the former avenger be able to prove his innocence? It doesn't matter, because Egghead won't give his long-time adversary a chance! As Hank walks to the witness stand the Masters of Evil attack!
Al Milgrom takes over the penciling in this issue. He would do the majority of the artwork until The Avengers #250 - World Power!
